name: PetPawCalc
tagline: Free calculators for dog and cat owners
description: Free calculators for dog and cat owners. Get instant, science-based answers on pet age, nutrition, weight, pregnancy, annual costs, and vet scheduling — no signup or hidden fees required. What PetPawCalc offers - Dog & Cat Age Calculator — Convert your pet's age to human years using size-adjusted formulas - Pet Food Calorie Calculator — Daily calorie needs based on weight, age, and activity level - Dog & Cat Weight Calculator — Healthy weight check by breed, or puppy/kitten adult size estimate -
